name: session-flow
description: Records what a session does (subagents, tools, skills, hooks, texts) to a local log, to follow it live or review it later.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Record sessions. Off, the plugin hooks nothing.

logDir.title: Log folder
logDir.description: Where session logs are written. Empty means ~/.claude/flow.

maxTextChars.title: Max text length
maxTextChars.description: Longer texts (prompts, outputs, answers) are cut to this many characters.

flushMs.title: Flush interval (ms)
flushMs.description: How often buffered records are written to the log.

viewerPort.title: Viewer port
viewerPort.description: Local port of the web viewer that /session-flow opens.
